title: 第29章 母子谈心
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
上辈子，魏建业的遗物就是几箱气象日记，这还是封存好几年过了时效性以后才还给家属。

    蔡老太也就剩这么点念想，所以闲暇之余总得翻翻看看，这一翻就是几十年。

    记事本在海岛已经受潮严重，年岁一久纸张更是泛黄发霉。

    蔡老太就一本本重新抄在新记事本上，一来二去全记在了脑海里。

    她对下

    姑娘心头一酸，仿佛压抑的委屈一下涌出来，吱呜一声哭了出来，倒进被子里。

    兰觅只是在他们身上停顿了几秒钟，伏觅的母亲对她还有一丝丝的情份，但她的父亲却一点点都没有。

    两世的认知，让她能够清楚的分辨出来，什么是喜欢，什么是爱。

    想到狐狸说她在这里不能与他有孩子顾浅浅心中也有些不是滋味的。但这件事她觉得必须要先提前的告知他一声。要是她们要待在这里很长很长一段时间，哪天他突然想要生孩子了怎么办？

    一家人洗漱过后，换上睡衣，就爬进各自的被窝，鼓捣自己的事情去了。

    去找大哥吧！大哥如今也在夜家，爸爸又不许她回家，言叶突然就发现自己其实根本就是无家可归。

    眼看着两个兵面面相窥，都一脸狐疑起来，端着枪慢慢又走了回来。

    她最见不得的，就是美人姐姐落泪了，特别还是祸水级别的美人流泪、那样她可会心疼的。

    “丫头，正经些，老夫真的有事情找你。”无语的看着凤栖玥，凤渠要求。

    “服装生意他们本来就做的不好，他们做的服装都是古装，可是这会儿大家喜欢的还是洋装。”陈浔阳回答妹妹的问题道，关于生意以及报复周家的事情，还是让陈浔阳过来跟妹妹说比较好。

    只有定向器官克隆技术，让全世界为之震动，可以说是惊天动地的技术大突破。

    以为，他们一行会一直被软禁在酒店，直到移植手术结束，然后灰溜溜地离开。

    如此形式下，周成以少胜多，攻陷长安的战役，自然成了一支强心剂，令人止不住狂喜莫名。

    爆发的音色引得她的眼眶之中流转着晶莹剔透的亮点，眼眶里只是温热的感觉，缓缓的，那流淌在眼眶子里的泪水已然想是弯弯的溪水，虽然只限于眼眶，却是从心中的那一个源头流露了出来。

    这一次任务的目标非常简单，据说是药剂师学院的院长——刘白石老爷爷的一个闪烁着魔法光芒的魔法头巾。

    招聘广告的最上方，是一段中华制造的公司简介，列数了公司的诸多产品，用以展示实力，不足为奇。

    “蒲你阿姆？想收拾我？我先收拾了你！搞不定你，我回去也交不了差！”宋天耀双眼眼角挑起，满是杀气。

    看了眼七八柄兵器，向擎天不由的摇了摇头，将那柄虎头刀拿过来，是猛虎伯爵的兵器，看起来很是华丽的东西。

    当然都是说笑的了，近来事情压抑，能开开玩笑，轻松一下气氛也好。

    宋天耀得知雷英东沉了一艘船的消息时，正与麦景陶一起打高尔夫球。

    佐藤秀中身上绿芒猛然一涨，景门瞬间开启……强悍的查克拉流，令周围的庞大压力的沙石顿时一松，双手努力的放在胸口结完手印，轻轻的碰触着周围的砂砾。

    林乔另一只手突然按着对方的胸膛往床上一推，然后一旋身就骑坐到了对方肚子上。
content_en:
In his previous life, Wei Jianye's relics were just a few boxes of weather diaries, which were sealed for several years before they were returned to his family.

    Old Mrs. Cai only had so much to think about, so she always had to look through it in her spare time, and she did so for decades.

    The notepad has been seriously affected by moisture on the island, and the paper has turned yellow and moldy over time.

    Mrs. Cai copied them one by one on her new notepad, remembering them all in her mind.

    She's right

    The girl felt sour in her heart, as if the suppressed grievances surged out all at once, she cried out loudly, and fell into the quilt.

    Lan Mi only paused on them for a few seconds. Fu Mi's mother still had a little affection for her, but her father had none at all.

    The knowledge of two lives allows her to clearly distinguish what is like and what is love.

    Gu Qianqian felt a little uncomfortable when she thought of Fox saying that she couldn't have children with him here. But she felt she had to inform him in advance about this. What if they are going to stay here for a long, long time and one day he suddenly wants to have a baby?

    After the family washed up, put on their pajamas, climbed into their own beds, and went about minding their own business.

    Go find big brother! The eldest brother is now at Ye's house, and her father doesn't allow her to go home. Yan Ye suddenly realizes that she is actually homeless.

    Seeing the two soldiers looking at each other, they both looked suspicious and slowly walked back with guns in hand.

    What she hates the most is when a beautiful sister sheds tears, especially if a beauty of calamity level sheds tears, which would make her feel distressed.

    "Girl, be more serious, I really have something to ask you." Feng Qu demanded, looking at Feng Qiyue speechlessly.

    "They are not doing well in the clothing business. The clothes they make are all ancient costumes, but what everyone likes now is dresses." Chen Xunyang answered his sister's question. Regarding business and revenge on the Zhou family, it would be better for Chen Xunyang to come over and talk to his sister.

    Only directed organ cloning technology has shocked the whole world. It can be said to be an earth-shattering technological breakthrough.

    I thought that their group would be kept under house arrest in the hotel until the transplant operation was over, and then they would leave in despair.

    Under such a situation, Zhou Cheng defeated the many with less, and the battle to capture Chang'an naturally became a shot in the arm, making people uncontrollably ecstatic.

    The explosive sound caused crystal clear highlights to flow in her eyes. There was only a warm feeling in her eyes. Slowly, the tears flowing in her eyes were already like meandering streams. Although they were limited to her eyes, they came out from the source in her heart.

    The goal of this mission is very simple. It is said to be a magic turban that shines with magic light belonging to Grandpa Liu Baishi, the dean of the Pharmacist College.

    At the top of the recruitment advertisement is a company profile of Made in China, which lists many of the company's products to demonstrate its strength. It is not surprising.

    "Pu, your mother-in-law? You want to deal with me? I'll deal with you first! If I can't deal with you, I won't be able to do anything when I go back!" Song Tianyao raised the corners of his eyes, full of murderous intent.

    After looking at the seven or eight weapons, Xiang Qingtian couldn't help but shook his head, and took the tiger head knife over. It was the weapon of Count Tiger, and it looked very gorgeous.

    Of course they are all joking. Things have been stressful lately, so it would be nice to joke around and lighten the mood.

    Song Tianyao was playing golf with McIntosh when he learned that Lei Yingdong had sunk a ship.

    The green light on Sato Shunaka's body suddenly rose, and the scenery gate opened instantly... The powerful chakra flow caused the surrounding sand and gravel to relax. He put his hands hard on his chest to complete the mudra, and gently touched the surrounding gravel.

    Lin Qiao suddenly pressed the other person's chest with his other hand and pushed him onto the bed, then spun around and sat on the other person's belly.
